verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud risk-decisioning platform, so passing agent identity into the risk decision is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, or delegated spending scopes as signals. Generic custom events and fields are a developer building block, not a first-class agent-identity signal, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass verified agent identity — agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, delegated spending scopes — into the risk decision as a first-class signal
